intro.narration: Night at the waiting shed. Kuya Rico is waiting — not for a jeep, but for his luck to turn.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Uy, ikaw 'yung bagong salta! Astig. Pautang ka nga ng pang-taya, bayad ko sa Linggo—promise.

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: Rico. Tatlong buwan nang 'sa Linggo.' Nandito ako para maningil.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Mang Bebot?! Bakit ka nandito—este, kumusta po! Ang kapal na ng listahan niyo ngayon ah!

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: Kaya nga. Manalo ka muna sa bata, baka may pambayad ka na.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Ay game! Kita mo, opportunity 'to. Investment lang, kuya. Trust the process.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: O sige, ikaw na mag-una—may tres kang kalburo diba? Lucky ka. Ako, wala—kahit pera.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Tahimik ka, gusto ko 'yan. Parang collector—walang sinasabi, basta kinukuha.

intro.narration: Rico patted his pocket. Empty. He smiled anyway.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Relax lang tayo. Kahit matalo 'ko, i-po-post-date ko lang naman 'yun, diba Bebot?

win.narration: Your hand is empty. Rico looked at the money he did not have.

win.speaker: kuya_rico
win.text: Talo 'ko?! Teka, hindi pa 'to final—may replay ba? Refund?

win.speaker: mang_bebot
win.text: Wala. Isusulat ko na lang 'to sa listahan mo, Rico. Dagdag.

win.speaker: kuya_rico
win.text: Grabe naman 'to! ...sige na nga. Pero investment 'to ha, babawi 'ko next quarter.

win.speaker: kuya_rico
win.text: Astig ka pala, bata. Sideline tayo minsan—50-50... 70-30... sa 'kin 'yung 70.

lose.narration: Time is up. Rico grinned like he won a lotto he never actually joined.

lose.speaker: kuya_rico
lose.text: Yes! Panalo! ...ibig sabihin, may pambayad na 'ko, Bebot?

lose.speaker: mang_bebot
lose.text: Hindi. Sa 'kin 'yang panalo mo. Bayad sa utang. Nakasulat.

lose.speaker: kuya_rico
lose.text: HA?! Ganon? ...sige, next time bata, babawi ka rin—kung may pautang ka.

lines.speaker: kuya_rico
lines.text: Teka, tatlo na lang 'ko—pwede bang i-installment na lang 'yung natitira?
